headlines.summary: 北京时间7月30日晚，中美经贸中方牵头人、国务院副总理何立峰与美方牵头人、美国财政部长贝森特和贸易代表格里尔举行视频通话，双方围绕落实好中美两国元首北京会晤重要共识，就下一阶段中美双方保持经贸关系稳定、拓展务实合作、妥善解决彼此关切，进行了坦诚、深入、富有建设性的交流。中方就近期美对华经贸限制措施表达严正关切。双方同意在两国元首战略引领下，进一步发挥好中美经贸磋商机制作用，加强沟通、增信释疑、拓展合作，推动中美经贸关系稳定向好，助力构建中美建设性战略稳定关系。（新华社）

headlines.title_en: He Lifeng holds video call with U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent and Trade Representative Jamieson Greer.
headlines.summary_en: On the evening of July 30 Beijing time, Chinese lead for China-US economic and trade affairs and Vice Premier He Lifeng held a video call with US counterparts, Treasury Secretary Bessent and Trade Representative Greer. Both sides conducted candid, in-depth, and constructive exchanges on implementing the important consensus reached between the two heads of state during their Beijing meeting, focusing on maintaining stable economic and trade relations, expanding practical cooperation, and appropriately addressing each other's concerns in the next phase. China expressed serious concerns over recent US economic and trade restrictive measures against China. Both sides agreed to further leverage the role of the China-US economic and trade consultation mechanism under the strategic guidance of the two heads of state, strengthen communication, enhance trust, clear doubts, expand cooperation, promote stable and positive development of China-US economic and trade relations, and help build a constructive and strategic stable relationship between China and the US. (Xinhua News Agency)

headlines.title_en: Macao SAR government signs cooperation agreement with MIIT on developing new quality productive forces and advancing new industrialization.
headlines.summary_en: The Macau SAR government and the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology signed the 'Cooperation Agreement on Developing New Quality Productive Forces to Advance New Industrialization' at the SAR government headquarters on the 30th. Secretary for Economy and Finance of the SAR government, Wu Hoixian, and Vice Minister of the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Xiong Jijun, signed the agreement on behalf of their respective sides. Both parties will strengthen exchanges and cooperation around supporting Macau's development of new quality productive forces and advancing new industrialization, helping Macau better integrate into and serve the national development landscape. (Xinhua Net)

headlines.title: 智利就Codelco引入私人资本释放复杂信号
headlines.summary: 随着智利财政部长Jorge Quiroz为私人资本的进入敞开大门，而智利国家铜业公司（Codelco）董事长Bernardo Fontaine却表示没有上市计划，智利官方就铜业巨头Codelco的未来释放了相互矛盾的信号。 尽管官员们在维持国家控制权方面立场一致，但财政部长Quiroz周三晚间表示，政府“在某个时候可能会引入私人资本”。然而，董事长Fontaine周四明确表示，Codelco并没有像其他一些国有公司那样，推进在股票市场出售股份的计划。

headlines.title_en: Chile sends mixed signals on bringing private capital into Codelco.
headlines.summary_en: As Chilean Finance Minister Jorge Quiroz opens the door for private capital entry, while Codelco Chairman Bernardo Fontaine states there are no listing plans, Chilean officials are sending conflicting signals about the future of copper giant Codelco. Although officials are united in maintaining state control, Finance Minister Quiroz said Wednesday evening that the government 'at some point may introduce private capital.' However, Chairman Fontaine made clear on Thursday that Codelco has no plans to advance the sale of shares on the stock market, unlike some other state-owned companies.

headlines.title_en: UK's 2-year bond yield falls over 11 basis points.
headlines.summary_en: In late European trading on Thursday (July 30), the UK 10-year bond yield fell 5.3 bps to a session low of 4.983%, having opened higher at 15:00 Beijing time to a session high of 5.052%, stabilizing at elevated levels before failing to test the top around 18:00 and declining steadily thereafter. The two-year UK bond yield fell 11.4 bps to 4.334%. The 30-year UK bond yield fell 1.7 bps, and the 50-year yield fell 2.3 bps. The 2/10-year UK bond yield spread rose 6.259 bps to +64.952 bps.

headlines.summary: 澳门特区政府与国家工业和信息化部30日在特区政府总部签署《关于发展新质生产力推进新型工业化的合作协议》。 特区政府经济财政司司长吴惠娴与国家工业和信息化部副部长熊继军分别代表澳门特区政府与国家工业和信息化部签署合作协议。双方将围绕支持澳门发展新质生产力、推进新型工业化等加强交流合作，助力澳门更好融入和服务国家发展大局。（新华网）

headlines.title: 宇树科技员工资管计划拟参与IPO战略配售，王兴兴认购1500万
headlines.summary: 宇树科技在首次公开发行股票并在科创板上市招股意向书披露，公司高级管理人员与核心员工拟通过资产管理计划参与本次发行战略配售，分别为宇树科技员工1号资管计划和宇树科技员工2号资管计划，参与战略配售的数量不超过本次发行规模的10%，即404.4643万股；同时参与认购金额合计不超过27,150万元，最终战略配售数量将在确定发行价格后确定。

headlines.title_en: Unitree Technology's employee asset management plan plans to participate in IPO strategic placement, Wang Xingxing subscribes 15 million yuan.
headlines.summary_en: Unitree Technology disclosed in its prospectus for its initial public offering and listing on the STAR Market that senior management and core employees plan to participate in the strategic placement of this issuance through asset management plans, namely Unitree Technology Employee No. 1 Asset Management Plan and Unitree Technology Employee No. 2 Asset Management Plan. The number of shares participating in the strategic placement shall not exceed 10% of the offering size, i.e., 4,044,643 shares; meanwhile, the total subscription amount shall not exceed RMB 271.5 million. The final number of strategic placement shares will be determined after the offering price is set.
